description: This file defines a Composable function 'MainScaffold' that sets up a main layout with bottom navigation bar and content area for different screens in an Android Jetpack Compose application. It also defines a data class for navigation items.

classes.name: NavItem
classes.description: Data class representing a navigation item with label, icon, and associated screen.

methods.name: MainScaffold
methods.description: Defines the main scaffold layout with bottom navigation and content switching based on current navigation state.
